title: Loss Assessment Limits Across the CondoGuard HO-6 Tiers
content:
Loss assessment coverage on the CondoGuard Unit-Owners Policy pays the unit owner's share of an assessment the association levies. Every tier includes a loss assessment limit in the package; more may be purchased above the included limit, up to the tier's highest total. The premium for purchased limit is an annual amount for each 5,000 USD purchased above the included limit.

| Tier | Included limit (USD) | Highest total limit (USD) | Annual premium per 5,000 USD purchased (USD) | Deductible assessment sublimit (USD) | Deductible per loss assessment claim (USD) |
|---|---|---|---|---|---|
| CondoGuard HO-6 Named Perils Essential | 1000 | 25000 | 9.00 | 1000 | 250 |
| CondoGuard HO-6 Named Perils Enhanced | 2000 | 25000 | 9.00 | 1000 | 250 |
| CondoGuard HO-6 Special Essential | 5000 | 50000 | 8.00 | 1000 | 250 |
| CondoGuard HO-6 Special Enhanced | 10000 | 50000 | 8.00 | 2500 | 250 |
| CondoGuard HO-6 Special Premier | 25000 | 100000 | 7.00 | 5000 | 0 |
| CondoGuard HO-6 Special Signature | 50000 | 100000 | 6.00 | 10000 | 0 |

**Column meanings.** The highest total limit counts the included limit and the purchased limit together. The deductible assessment sublimit is the most paid for an assessment that passes on the association's master policy deductible. The deductible per loss assessment claim is taken from each loss assessment claim; on CondoGuard HO-6 Special Premier and CondoGuard HO-6 Special Signature it is 0.

## Illustrations (hypothetical figures)

- CondoGuard HO-6 Special Essential with the included 5000 USD raised to a total of 15000 USD: 10000 USD is purchased, which is two lots of 5,000 USD at 8.00 USD each, an annual premium of 16.00 USD.
- CondoGuard HO-6 Named Perils Enhanced can reach a total of 25000 USD and no more; a total of 30000 USD is above its highest total.
- An assessment passing on the master policy deductible is paid on CondoGuard HO-6 Special Enhanced up to 2500 USD at most.
